drums.description: Acoustic folk and percussion, The track features a dry, close-miked acoustic guitar playing a repetitive fingerstyle pattern in 4/4 time, A hand-clapping rhythm provides the primary percussion, accented by a wooden block or rimshot sound on the backbeat, A shaker maintains a steady sixteenth-note pulse, The tempo is 100 BPM, The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the syncopated guitar melody and the organic percussion elements, The guitar uses a standard tuning with a bright, steel-string timbre, No bass or melodic accompaniment is present beyond the single guitar track Publish

bass.description: Funk-rock instrumental, A clean, compressed electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and palm-muted staccato notes, The electric bass follows the guitar rhythm with a bright, mid-forward tone, emphasizing the downbeat of each measure, A drum kit maintains a steady groove with a tight, dry snare and a consistent kick pattern, The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time, The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar scratching and the locked bass and drum section Publish
